title: Synthesis wall after six sessions
prompt: Photograph of a white studio wall during usability research synthesis: square sticky notes in yellow, pink and pale blue arranged in five loose vertical columns, every note completely blank, the fourth column noticeably fuller with a tight cluster of pink notes, a few lengths of thin red string pinned between columns, one anonymous hand entering from the right edge to move a note, soft even daylight, slight angle, documentary style, calm and orderly.
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
